description: ctrlyoke built-in agents for workflow composition, orchestration, testing, and support

agents.label: ctrlyoke Workflow Composer
agents.description: Composes a ctrlyoke workflow file (.ctrlyoke.yaml) from a feature request. Turns your task into a structured, multi-step workflow another agent can run.

agents.label: Spec Orchestrator
agents.description: Orchestrating reviewer for spec-driven loops. Reviews completed work against the spec and queues follow-up prompts if gaps remain.

agents.label: Test Repair
agents.description: Diagnoses and fixes failing tests surfaced by an end-condition retry loop. Finds the root cause and makes the smallest correct fix without masking failures.

agents.label: ctrlyoke Tech Support
agents.description: Answers ctrlyoke setup, workflow authoring, dashboard, harness, MCP, agent/skill, validation, session, and troubleshooting questions using bundled product knowledge.
